hook.say: Does a bigger country mean more people? Not always. Who has more? Five duels, three seconds each!

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!

questions.q: Which has more people: Mongolia or Ireland?
questions.fact: Ireland: 5.4 million people. Mongolia, 22 times larger: 3.6 million (2026).
questions.sayAnswer: Ireland! It has about five point four million people. Mongolia is twenty-two times larger, with only about three and a half million.

questions.q: Which has more people: Kazakhstan or the Netherlands?
questions.fact: Kazakhstan: 21 million. Netherlands, 65 times smaller: 18.4 million (2026).
questions.sayAnswer: Kazakhstan! It has about twenty-one million people. The Netherlands is sixty-five times smaller, with about eighteen and a half million.

questions.q: Which has more people: Argentina or Kenya?
questions.fact: Kenya has about 59 million people, Argentina about 46 million (UN, 2026).
questions.sayAnswer: Kenya! It has about fifty-nine million people. Argentina has about forty-six million.

questions.q: Which has more people: Uganda or Canada?
questions.fact: Uganda has about 53 million people, Canada about 40 million (UN, 2026).
questions.sayAnswer: Uganda! It has about fifty-three million people. Canada has about forty million.

questions.q: Which has more people: Libya or Switzerland?
questions.fact: Switzerland: 9 million people. Libya, 43 times larger: 7.5 million (2026).
questions.sayAnswer: Switzerland! It has about nine million people. Libya is forty-three times larger, with seven and a half million.
